provenance.ephemeris: JHora 8.0 jhcore/ephe .se1 files (Swiss Ephemeris compression of JPL DE431)
provenance.convention: JHora defaults: geocentric, SEFLG_TRUEPOS, ET = UT + swe_deltat, planets and angles = tropical − geometric True-Chitra (Spica 180°) ayanamsa
provenance.bodies: sidereal ecliptic longitude, degrees; MeanNode = SE_MEAN_NODE, TrueNode = SE_TRUE_NODE
provenance.houses: swe_houses(UT, lat, lon, hsys) minus ayanamsa; ret −1 means swe_houses fell back to Porphyry (Placidus beyond the polar circle)
provenance.use: test fixture only; engine code never imports this file
